title: Larkhollow Landscape Studio
summary: Landscape design and build in west Toronto, redrawn as a field guide folio. Plate I is an engraved block diagram of the garden that draws itself in ink; scrolling cuts it open and lifts the pergola, plants, stone, sand, gravel and fabric apart with a numbered key in real build order, then builds it back. A specimen index of Ontario natives filters by light and season, and the booking form is a yard walk request slip.
layout: folio spread: text page left, engraved plate right
theme: herbarium sage card, iron gall ink, gilt and botanical colour plates
blurb: A garden drawn in ink that lifts apart in build order.

title: Larkhollow Landscape Studio, EN / 中文
summary: The landscaper concept as one bilingual page: an EN / 中文 switch swaps every word in place, Chinese copy written for Chinese readers, a layer legend in both languages, and a booking form with language and WeChat fields.
blurb: One page, two languages, switched in place.

title: Brindlewick Roofing
summary: Fictional residential roofer in east Toronto, redone as a riso printed one object page: an isometric house drawn in three inks. Scrolling lifts the roof off, fans it into an exploded parts diagram, lights each of the seven layers in real install order, puts them back deck first, then rain runs off into the eavestrough. Work order form with a rubber stamp.
layout: full bleed poster, headline overprinted on the house
theme: cool paper ground, three riso inks: federal blue, fluorescent pink, yellow
blurb: Scroll to take a roof apart, layer by layer.

title: Ninefold Bakehouse
summary: Fictional sourdough bakery in Toronto's east end. The first screen is a working pre order composer set as a bakery counter: the headline sits behind a large drawn bag and the order controls run along a receipt strip under it; pick a day and loaves and tomorrow's bag is drawn with them in it. Then the night: a dough sheet is folded nine times by scroll or by hand, shaped, scored and baked. Every loaf is grown in code from its own seed; tap one on the rack to slice it and see its crumb.
theme: drenched wheat ground, rye ink, receipt paper
blurb: Fill tomorrow's bag tonight; every loaf grown in code.

title: ArchLine Haojiang Renovation
summary: Toronto renovation studio. Project gallery, services through permits, and a 3D Showcase where a house opens into its materials as you scroll.
blurb: Renovation and design build, with a 3D house that opens up as you scroll.

title: Daniel's Kitchen
summary: Friday dinners from a Bocuse d'Or Team Canada chef: weekly menu, order countdown and a 35 second promo video.
blurb: Friday dinners from a Bocuse d'Or Team Canada chef, with a 35 second promo.

title: Evas Cafes
summary: A matcha and coffee bar told from bean to cup: a scroll film pours the drinks, then a menu of six with placeholder prices.
blurb: From bean to cup, poured by your scroll.

title: Lahab Shawarma
summary: Shawarma off the fire: scroll the flame, then build your own wrap and watch the order fill in. Demo only, no order is placed.
blurb: Scroll the fire, then build your own wrap.

title: Velune Cliff Villas
summary: Twelve fictional cliff villas above the Andaman Sea: a sunset hero film, villas in a triptych, a day at Velune and an availability check.
blurb: Twelve cliff villas at sunset, with an availability check.

title: Hao Jiang Archline, 3D Showcase
summary: A warm industrial renovation film: construction site to kitchen to living room, then every material taken apart. Approved by the client.
blurb: A renovation film from bare site to finished home, materials taken apart.

title: Terminal X Auto Detailing
summary: Markham detailing studio: one continuous film from the wash bay into the seats, the cleaning taken apart, then back out to the pressure wash.
blurb: One continuous film from the wash bay into the seats and back out.

title: Kestrel Movers
summary: A 3D toy world of yard, storage, route and delivery that you scroll through, one stop of the move at a time.
blurb: A 3D toy world of the whole move, yard to doorstep.

title: Ninth Room Gallery
summary: Walk a contemporary gallery room by room in 3D, every image drawn in code.
blurb: Walk a gallery room by room, every image drawn in code.

title: Paperbolt Studio
summary: A fictional Toronto marketing studio: brand, social, ads, websites and video, told through one pinned colour burst film.
blurb: A marketing studio told through one colour burst film.
